title: Tax incentives, compliance costs, and VAT registration: evidence from India
title_zh: 税收激励、合规成本与增值税登记：来自印度的证据
title_primary: 税收激励、合规成本与增值税登记：来自印度的证据
title_secondary: Tax incentives, compliance costs, and VAT registration: evidence from India
authors: Ross Warwick, Tushar Nandi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Value-added tax (VAT) is the largest source of tax revenue for many developing country governments, and sales-based registration thresholds are a ubiquitous design feature. Yet, empirical evidence on the mechanisms through which these thresholds alter firm behaviour remains scarce. Using administrative tax data from West Bengal in India, we study the behavioural responses of firms to a turnover threshold for compulsory VAT registration. By exploiting variation in the tax discontinuity at the registration threshold across firms and over time, we show that tax incentives, rather than compliance costs, drive the observed bunching of firms below the threshold, and their associated revealed preference for a simplified tax scheme. The limited role for VAT compliance costs relative to a simplified tax regime has important implications for the design of small business taxation and for the optimal level of VAT registration thresholds.
abstract_zh: 增值税（VAT）是许多发展中国家政府最大的税收来源，而基于销售额的注册门槛是一种普遍存在的设计特征。然而，关于这些门槛如何改变企业行为的实证证据仍然稀缺。利用印度西孟加拉邦的行政税收数据，我们研究了企业对强制性增值税注册营业额门槛的行为反应。通过利用注册门槛处税收不连续性在企业间及时间上的变化，我们表明，是税收激励而非合规成本，驱动了观察到的企业聚集于门槛以下的现象，以及它们对简化税制的显性偏好。相较于简化税制，增值税合规成本的作用有限，这对小企业税收设计及增值税注册门槛的最优水平具有重要启示。

title: Decomposing Cyclical Grocery Prices: Store and Household Responses
title_zh: 分解周期性食品杂货价格：门店与家庭反应
title_primary: 分解周期性食品杂货价格：门店与家庭反应
title_secondary: Decomposing Cyclical Grocery Prices: Store and Household Responses
authors: Richard Friberg, Thor Andreas Aursland, Frode Steen, Simen Ulsaker
official: 官方在线 2026-09-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how grocery prices paid by households respond to local economic conditions, using the 2014 oil price collapse as a regional unemployment shock in Norway and combining transaction histories for 100,000 households with weekly store-level price data. We derive an exact decomposition of the change in the average price a household pays, whose components, assigned to retailer pricing or distinct household behaviors, sum to the total causal effect when estimated by regression. Prices paid are procyclical: retailer price responses account for about ten percent of the decline, while the dominant channel — over half the total effect — is households timing purchases to temporary sales. The dominance of within-quarter timing implies that unit-value price indexes conflate retailer pricing with household behavior, increasingly so in downturns.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2014年油价暴跌作为挪威区域性失业冲击，结合10万户家庭的交易记录与每周店铺层面的价格数据，研究家庭支付的食品杂货价格如何响应地方经济状况。我们推导出家庭平均支付价格变化的精确分解，其各组成部分——归因于零售商定价或不同家庭行为——在通过回归估计时，总和等于总因果效应。支付价格呈顺周期性：零售商价格响应约占下降幅度的十分之一，而主导渠道——占总效应的一半以上——是家庭将购买时机对准临时促销。季度内时机选择的主导地位意味着，单位价值价格指数混淆了零售商定价与家庭行为，且在经济衰退时期这种混淆程度加剧。

title: Estimating Aggregate Human Capital Externalities
title_zh: 估计总体人力资本外部性
title_primary: 估计总体人力资本外部性
title_secondary: Estimating Aggregate Human Capital Externalities
authors: Junjie Guo, Nicolas Roys, Ananth Seshadri
official: 官方在线 2026-08-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper estimates two measures of human capital externalities. By incorporating externalities into an overlapping-generations model of human capital accumulation with Compulsory Schooling Laws (CSL), we show that human capital externalities can be estimated from the effects of CSL for one generation on wages of other generations. Using an instrumental-variable strategy deduced from the model, we find one more year of average schooling at the U.S. state level raises individual wages by 6-8%. Taking this reduced-form estimate into account, we find the elasticity of a typical firm’s productivity with respect to the average human capital of an economy is 0.121.
abstract_zh: 本文估算了人力资本外部性的两种度量。通过将外部性纳入一个包含义务教育法（CSL）的人力资本积累重叠世代模型中，我们表明，人力资本外部性可以从一代人的CSL对其他代际工资的影响中估计出来。利用从模型推导出的工具变量策略，我们发现美国州级平均教育年限每增加一年，个人工资提高6%-8%。考虑到这一简化形式估计，我们发现典型企业生产率对经济体平均人力资本的弹性为0.121。

title: Turning inward and/or outward: Which socioemotional skills pay for agribusiness entrepreneurs in Nigeria?
title_zh: 向内和/或向外转向：哪些社会情感技能对尼日利亚农业企业创业者有回报？
title_primary: 向内和/或向外转向：哪些社会情感技能对尼日利亚农业企业创业者有回报？
title_secondary: Turning inward and/or outward: Which socioemotional skills pay for agribusiness entrepreneurs in Nigeria?
authors: Smita Das, Clara Delavallade, Ayodele Fashogbon, Sreelakshmi Papineni
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Socioemotional skills (SES) programs are widely used to promote economic empowerment, yet their returns may depend on the type of skills targeted and social context. We study this question using a randomized controlled trial (RCT) among 4500 aspiring agribusiness entrepreneurs in Nigeria within a large-scale government program. Participants were randomly assigned to an interpersonal-skills curriculum, a combined interpersonal and intrapersonal-skills curriculum of the same length, or a control group. Both trainings substantially increase women’s business performance, raising average profits by 50%. The two trainings generated broadly similar economic impacts overall. Effects are largest in communities with more liberal gender norms, where women report improvements in interpersonal skills such as empathy and negotiation, and better relational outcomes. Despite large economic gains, we find no corresponding increases in women’s empowerment or intrahousehold decision-making. For men, interpersonal-skills training increases household income, while the combined curriculum raises profits but only in the most gender-liberal environments. The results show that the returns to SES depend not only on which skills are taught, but also on whether prevailing social norms permit individuals to express and deploy those skills. Translating gains into broader empowerment may require complementary programs that relax gender norms.
abstract_zh: 社会情感技能（SES）项目被广泛用于促进经济赋权，然而其回报可能取决于所针对的技能类型及社会背景。我们通过一项随机对照试验（RCT）来研究这一问题，该试验在尼日利亚一个大规模政府项目中，对4500名有志于农业综合企业创业的个体进行了研究。参与者被随机分配至人际技能课程、同等时长的人际与内在技能综合课程，或对照组。两种培训均显著提升了女性的经营绩效，使平均利润增加了50%。总体而言，这两种培训在经济影响上大致相似。在性别规范更为自由化的社区中，效果最为显著，这些地区的女性报告称，其在同理心、谈判等人际技能方面有所提升，且关系性结果更佳。尽管经济收益显著，我们并未观察到女性赋权或家庭内部决策权的相应提升。对于男性而言，人际技能培训增加了家庭收入，而综合课程则提高了利润，但仅限于性别观念最为开放的环境中。研究结果表明，社会情感技能的回报不仅取决于所教授的技能类型，还取决于现行社会规范是否允许个体表达和运用这些技能。将收益转化为更广泛的赋权，可能需要辅以放松性别规范的补充项目。

title: Value of Information in Social Learning
title_zh: 社会学习中信息的价值
title_primary: 社会学习中信息的价值
title_secondary: Value of Information in Social Learning
authors: Hiroto Sato, Konan Shimizu
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study extends Blackwell (1953) comparison of information to a sequential social learning model in which agents make decisions sequentially based on both private signals and observed actions of others. In this context, we introduce a binary relation over information structures: an information structure is more socially valuable than another if it yields higher expected payoffs for all agents, regardless of their preferences and equilibrium realizations. First, we establish that this binary relation is strictly stronger than the Blackwell order. Next, we provide a necessary and sufficient condition for our binary relation and propose a simpler sufficient condition that is easier to verify. We further explore comparisons of information structures in terms of long-run payoffs, limit welfare, and canonical binary environments.
abstract_zh: 本研究将Blackwell（1953）的信息比较扩展至序贯社会学习模型，在该模型中，代理人基于私人信号及观察到的他人行为依次做出决策。在此背景下，我们引入了一种关于信息结构的二元关系：若一种信息结构对所有代理人而言，无论其偏好及均衡实现如何，均能产生更高的预期收益，则称其比另一种更具社会价值。首先，我们确立该二元关系严格强于Blackwell序。其次，我们给出该二元关系的充要条件，并提出一个更易验证的简化充分条件。我们进一步探讨了信息结构在长期收益、极限福利及典型二元环境中的比较。

title: Credit and Firms' Organization
title_zh: 信贷与企业组织
title_primary: 信贷与企业组织
title_secondary: Credit and Firms' Organization
authors: Alessandro Sforza, Edoardo Maria Acabbi, Stephen Lin, Catherine Thomas, Arturs Kalnins 等
official: 官方在线 2025-07-07 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We investigate how credit availability affects the organization of firms' labor. We construct a firm-specific credit supply instrument derived from firm-bank credit linkages, and conduct an event study analyzing labor restructuring decisions within Portuguese firms. Our analysis uncovers a clear nexus between credit availability and labor adjustments. Specifically, firms that invest in machines and equipment are more sensitive to credit shortages. As a result, they tend to adjust their workforce by reducing the number of production and specialized workers closely associated with machine operations. These findings shed light on how credit dynamics shape labor decisions within firms, providing insights into aggregate responses to financial limitations.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了信贷可得性如何影响企业的劳动力组织。我们构建了一个基于企业-银行信贷联系的企业特定信贷供给工具，并通过事件研究法分析了葡萄牙企业内部的重组决策。分析揭示出信贷可得性与劳动力调整之间存在明确关联。具体而言，投资于机器设备的企业对信贷短缺更为敏感。因此，这些企业倾向于通过减少与机器操作紧密相关的生产工人和专业人员数量来调整其劳动力结构。这些发现阐明了信贷动态如何塑造企业内部劳动力决策，为理解金融限制下的总体反应提供了洞见。

title: Immigration, Inequality and Income Taxes
title_zh: 移民、不平等与所得税
title_primary: 移民、不平等与所得税
title_secondary: Immigration, Inequality and Income Taxes
authors: Mirjam Bächli, Albrecht Glitz
official: 官方在线 2024-12-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Immigration may affect income inequality not only by changing factor prices but also by inducing policy makers to adjust the prevailing income tax system. We assess the relative importance of these economic and political channels using administrative data from Switzerland where local authorities have a high degree of tax autonomy. We show that immigrant inflows not only raise gross earnings inequality but also reduce the progressivity of local income taxes, further increasing after-tax inequality. Our estimates suggest that around 10 percent of the impact of immigration on the net interquartile and interdecile earnings gaps can be attributed to the political channel.
abstract_zh: 移民不仅可能通过改变要素价格影响收入不平等，还可能促使政策制定者调整现行所得税制度。我们利用瑞士的行政数据评估了这些经济与政治渠道的相对重要性，该国地方当局拥有高度的税收自主权。我们证明，移民流入不仅提高了总收入的差距，还降低了地方所得税的累进性，进一步加剧了税后不平等。我们的估计表明，移民对净四分位距和十分位距收入差距的影响中，约有10%可归因于政治渠道。

title: How Fixed are Global Exchange Rates?
title_zh: 全球汇率究竟有多固定？
title_primary: 全球汇率究竟有多固定？
title_secondary: How Fixed are Global Exchange Rates?
authors: O, Vicquery, Roger
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We present a new global index indicating how fixed are the world's exchange rates. Our index measures the probability of two units of GDP, randomly selected anywhere in the world, of being involved in a fixed exchange rate arrangement. This approach is invariant to alternative classifications of the Eurozone and is able to account for both direct and indirect exchange rate linkages between countries. In contrast to the "New Consensusâ€ view, which posits a continuity in exchange rate arrangements from the Bretton Woods era to the present, our index restores the conventional account of international monetary history over the last 70 years. Our findings indicate that global exchange rate fixity is now nearly three times smaller than prior to the 1971 Nixon shock, when major anchor currencies were pegged to each other. Furthermore, our measure partially puts into perspective the view that dollar dominance is now stronger than ever: we find that global anchoring to the US dollar was significantly more prevalent during Bretton Woods, particularly when accounting for indirect links.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个新的全球指数，用以衡量世界汇率固定程度。该指数衡量的是全球随机选取的两个GDP单位，其处于固定汇率安排下的概率。此方法不受欧元区不同分类方式的影响，并能同时考虑国家间直接与间接的汇率联系。与“新共识”观点相反——该观点认为自布雷顿森林体系时期至今，汇率安排具有连续性——我们的指数重塑了过去70年国际货币历史的传统叙述。研究结果显示，当前全球汇率固定程度几乎比1971年尼克松冲击前（当时主要锚定货币相互挂钩）低三倍。此外，我们的衡量标准在一定程度上对“美元主导地位空前强化”的观点提出了修正：我们发现，在布雷顿森林体系时期，全球对美元的锚定程度显著更高，尤其是在考虑间接联系时。

title: Balancing Growth in a Warming World
title_zh: 变暖世界中的增长平衡
title_primary: 变暖世界中的增长平衡
title_secondary: Balancing Growth in a Warming World
authors: Adrien Bilal, Thibault Ingrand, Diego R. Känzig
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a theory of balanced growth and optimal climate policy in an integrated assessment framework. Balanced growth is possible despite climate change, but at a slower rate. Two distinct policy regimes emerge because emissions permanently raise carbon stocks. For low damages, optimal growth coincides with the laissez-faire and carbon is priced at a constant rate. For high damages, optimal policy caps temperature growth to prevent escalating losses and achieve faster economic growth than in the laissez-faire by pricing carbon at an increasing rate. We quantify our model and show that empirical damage estimates span both regimes. For low damages, optimal policy achieves a 1% welfare gain with 3 to 8°C of warming per century and no change in long-run growth. For high damages, optimal policy raises annual growth by 0.8 percentage points and achieves a 26% welfare gain by capping warming at 0.4°C per century.
abstract_zh: 本文在综合评估框架下构建了平衡增长与最优气候政策的理论。尽管存在气候变化，平衡增长仍可实现，但增速放缓。由于排放会永久性提高碳存量，因此出现了两种截然不同的政策机制。在低损害情形下，最优增长与自由放任政策一致，碳定价保持恒定比率。在高损害情形下，最优政策通过设定温度增长上限以防止损失加剧，并以递增的碳定价实现比自由放任更快的经济增长。我们对模型进行了量化分析，表明经验损害估计跨越了这两种机制。在低损害下，最优政策实现1%的福利增益，每世纪升温3至8摄氏度，且长期增长不变。在高损害下，最优政策通过将升温限制在每世纪0.4摄氏度，使年增长率提高0.8个百分点，并实现26%的福利增益。

title: When co-managed conservation fails: Environmental degradation and state-backed dispossession of indigenous lands in communal reserves in the Peruvian Amazon
title_zh: 共同管理保护失败之时：秘鲁亚马逊社区保护区中的环境退化与国家支持的原住民土地剥夺
title_primary: 共同管理保护失败之时：秘鲁亚马逊社区保护区中的环境退化与国家支持的原住民土地剥夺
title_secondary: When co-managed conservation fails: Environmental degradation and state-backed dispossession of indigenous lands in communal reserves in the Peruvian Amazon
authors: Hernán Manrique, Daniel Hernando, Dennis Meza, Iván Brehaut, Constanza Parra
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Communal Reserves were established as a co-management compromise between the Peruvian state and Amazonian indigenous peoples to promote biodiversity conservation and indigenous territorial rights. However, these areas face escalating land grabbing, environmental degradation and violence. This study utilizes archival, spatial, and ethnographic data to analyze the magnitude, drivers, and mechanisms of Land Use and Land Cover Change (LULCC) in El Sira Communal Reserve and its buffer zone. We find that current pressures stem from a longstanding legacy of state-led colonization and agricultural development preceding the reserve’s creation. Our spatial analysis shows that El Sira’s deforestation and agricultural expansion rates are the highest among all Peruvian Communal Reserves and their buffer zones. Finally, our ethnographic action research highlights the role of subnational governments in facilitating LULCC through state-backed dispossession of indigenous lands. Our discussion exposes the limitations of co-managed conservation in the Central Peruvian Amazon, where growth coalitions and a legacy of settler colonization provide the administrative infrastructure necessary to transform protected forests into private assets.
abstract_zh: 社区保护区（Communal Reserves）是秘鲁国家与亚马逊原住民之间为促进生物多样性保护和原住民土地权利而建立的共同管理折中方案。然而，这些区域正面临日益严重的土地侵占、环境退化和暴力问题。本研究利用档案、空间和民族志数据，分析埃尔西拉社区保护区及其缓冲区内土地利用与土地覆盖变化（LULCC）的规模、驱动因素和机制。我们发现，当前的压力源于保护区建立之前长期存在的国家主导的殖民化和农业发展遗留问题。空间分析显示，埃尔西拉地区的森林砍伐和农业扩张率在秘鲁所有社区保护区及其缓冲区中最高。最后，我们的民族志行动研究揭示了地方政府在通过国家支持的原住民土地剥夺促进LULCC中所扮演的角色。我们的讨论揭示了秘鲁中部亚马逊地区共同管理保护的局限性，在那里，增长联盟和定居者殖民化的遗留问题提供了将受保护森林转变为私人资产所需的行政基础设施。

title: Objective vs. Perceived Corporate Greenness: Do Individuals Understand Corporate Sustainability Information?
title_zh: 客观绿色度与感知绿色度：个体能否理解企业可持续信息？
title_primary: 客观绿色度与感知绿色度：个体能否理解企业可持续信息？
title_secondary: Objective vs. Perceived Corporate Greenness: Do Individuals Understand Corporate Sustainability Information?
authors: Kornelia Fabisik, Sebastian Rink
official: 官方在线 2026-07-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We investigate how individuals interpret corporate sustainability disclosures in a pre-registered survey experiment. We provide novel evidence that participants can meaningfully distinguish greener from browner firms, yet their assessments exhibit a central tendency bias. Interestingly, this bias is asymmetric: respondents overestimate the greenness of browner firms while underestimating the greenness of greener firms more strongly. The same pattern persists among finance professionals and sustainability experts, suggesting that expertise alone does not eliminate interpretation errors. Consequently, firms’ incentives to invest in emissions reductions may be attenuated. We further identify disclosure design features that enhance individuals’ ability to differentiate firms’ emissions performance.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项预注册的问卷调查实验，探究个体如何解读企业可持续发展披露信息。我们提供了新颖的证据，表明参与者能够有意义地区分更环保与更不环保的企业，然而其评估存在中心趋势偏差。有趣的是，这种偏差具有不对称性：受访者高估了较不环保企业的绿色程度，同时更显著地低估了更环保企业的绿色程度。这一模式在金融专业人士和可持续发展专家中同样存在，表明专业知识本身并不能消除解读错误。因此，企业投资于减排的激励可能被削弱。我们进一步识别出能够增强个体区分企业排放绩效能力的披露设计特征。

title: Money in a Real Business Cycle Model
title_zh: 真实商业周期模型中的货币
title_primary: 真实商业周期模型中的货币
title_secondary: Money in a Real Business Cycle Model
authors: Roger Farmer, Alice Albonico, Guido Ascari, Alessandro Gobbi, Ippei Fujiwara 等
official: 官方在线 1997-04-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper constructs a real business cycle model in which real money balances yield utility. We calibrate the model to fit the first moments of US data and simulate a set of impulse response functions that are generated by the model for GDP, the rate of interest, money growth and real balances. These theoretical impulse responses are compared with actual impulse responses from US data. The model does a reasonably good job of capturing the dynamic interactions of money and real variables in US data. It differs from most existing approaches by choosing a parameterization of utility for which the model admits the existence of indeterminate equilibria. It is argued that this fact is critical in explaining the monetary propagation mechanism.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个真实货币余额产生效用的实际经济周期模型。我们通过校准模型使其拟合美国数据的一阶矩，并模拟了模型生成的GDP、利率、货币增长及实际余额的一组脉冲响应函数。将这些理论脉冲响应与美国数据的实际脉冲响应进行比较，发现该模型较好地捕捉了美国数据中货币与实际变量的动态交互关系。与现有大多数方法不同，本文选择了允许模型存在不确定均衡的效用参数化设定。研究认为，这一特性对于解释货币传导机制至关重要。

title: DP517 Adjustment Difficulties within a European Monetary Union: Can They be Reduced?

abstract: This paper analyses four costs which may be associated with monetary union. First it (obviously) allows no `relative' monetary accommodation of the kind which may assist when dealing with asymmetric shocks. This can impose significant adjustment costs. Second it does not of itself prevent `absolute' accommodation to an inflation shock originating in all members, or even one member, of the union. Third, the distribution of benefits of membership of the union may be skewed. Finally, a union may require significant fiscal flexibility to mitigate against the adjustment costs. We investigate the form of fiscal flexibility which may be required, and we also propose a form of Soft Monetary Union which might alleviate the first problem.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了与货币联盟可能相关的四种成本。首先，（显然）货币联盟不允许那种有助于应对非对称冲击的“相对”货币调节，这可能带来显著的调整成本。其次，货币联盟本身并不阻止对源于所有成员国甚至单一成员国的通胀冲击进行“绝对”调节。第三，联盟成员国的收益分配可能不均衡。最后，货币联盟可能需要显著的财政灵活性以缓解调整成本。我们探讨了可能需要的财政灵活性形式，并提出了一种可能缓解第一个问题的“软性货币联盟”模式。

abstract: Using large-scale high-granularity data from a food delivery platform and granular pollution and weather information, we study how PM 2.5 fluctuations affect riders' absenteeism, productivity, and accidents. Exploiting exogenous pollution variation from inverse boundary layer height, we find that higher pollution increases absenteeism for all workers and raises delivery times and accident rates only among (e-)bike riders, who must exert physical effort while working. Affected workers compensate productivity losses by working longer hours. Monetary incentives mitigate the effects on absenteeism but do not offset the decline in productivity and appear to exacerbate accident risk.
abstract_zh: 利用某外卖平台的大规模高粒度数据以及细颗粒物污染与天气信息，我们研究了PM2.5波动如何影响骑手的缺勤、生产率及事故发生率。借助逆边界层高度带来的外生污染变化，我们发现污染加剧会增加所有工人的缺勤率，并仅提高（电动）自行车骑手的配送时间和事故率，这些骑手在工作中需付出体力劳动。受影响的工人通过延长工作时间来弥补生产率损失。金钱激励缓解了缺勤效应，但并未抵消生产率下降，反而似乎加剧了事故风险。

abstract: We provide experimental evidence on the intergenerational impacts of secondary education subsidies in a low-income context, leveraging a randomized controlled trial and 15-year longitudinal follow-up. Secondary school scholarships delay fertility, reduce unwanted pregnancies and change partner selection. Under-one mortality is reduced by half. We also document cognitive development gains of 0.24 standard deviations of test scores by age 5 among children of female scholarship recipients. Means-tested secondary school scholarships are a high return investment, with a conservatively estimated $4.1 in benefits for each $1 the policy would cost the government in the long-run.

authors: Ceren Ozgen, Matt Cole, Liza Jabbour, Hiromi Yumoto, Petra Gram Cavalca 等

abstract: We explore whether a civic integration exam component dedicated to labor market training, namely the ONA - a type of job search assistance program, boosts refugees’ economic outcomes and the quality of firms they work for. Using linked employer-employee (monthly) data from 2014 to 2021 for the Netherlands and Regression Discontinuity design, we find that taking the ONA sped up and deepened the economic integration of refugees for at least 3 years in terms of increased employment probability and higher hourly wages. We further show that taking the ONA results in refugees working for larger, less routine-task intensive, higher wage firms. These results reflect improvements in both match efficiency and match quality. The ONA therefore does more than reduce search frictions: it equips refugees with the knowledge to navigate the labor market effectively and find employment that aligns better with their existing abilities and human capital.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了公民融合考试中专门针对劳动力市场培训的一个组成部分，即ONA——一种求职援助项目，是否能提升难民的经济成果及其所服务企业的质量。利用荷兰2014年至2021年关联雇主-雇员（月度）数据及断点回归设计，我们发现参加ONA加速并深化了难民的经济融合，至少在3年内表现为就业概率提高和小时工资上升。我们进一步表明，参加ONA导致难民在规模更大、常规任务密集度较低、工资更高的企业中工作。这些结果反映了匹配效率和匹配质量的提升。因此，ONA不仅仅减少了搜索摩擦：它赋予难民有效驾驭劳动力市场的知识，并找到与其现有能力和人力资本更契合的就业机会。

abstract: Europe has devoted substantial resources to fostering innovation and AI diffusion, through both centralised EU initiatives and national programmes. This column combines an experiment on 3,316 euro area firms with data from a large firm survey to demonstrate that that the decision to adopt AI is primarily driven by competition pressures rather than informational spillovers. If firms systematically underestimate their competitors’ AI investment – especially those abroad – informational gaps could be driving underinvestment. Reducing invisible barriers to knowledge sharing across regions may be just as vital as financial support for closing gaps in AI investment and innovation across Europe.
abstract_zh: 欧洲通过欧盟集中倡议和国家计划投入了大量资源，以促进创新和人工智能的扩散。本专栏结合一项针对3316家欧元区企业的实验以及大型企业调查数据，表明企业采用人工智能的决策主要受竞争压力驱动，而非信息溢出效应。如果企业系统性地低估其竞争对手（尤其是海外竞争对手）的人工智能投资，信息差距可能导致投资不足。减少跨区域知识共享的隐形障碍，对于缩小欧洲人工智能投资与创新差距而言，可能与财政支持同等重要。

title: In their Shoes: Empathy Through Information
title_zh: 感同身受：信息中的共情
title_primary: 感同身受：信息中的共情

authors: Marianne Andries, Leonardo Bursztyn, Thomas Chaney, Milena Djourelova, Alex Imas
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We explore the mechanics of empathy. We show that information about an outgroup can activate and magnify empathy when presented in conjunction with an experience simulating their struggles. This response increases the willingness to help the struggling group. We provide evidence for this effect in an immersive virtual reality experiment where participants (“witnesses”) experience a simulation of the struggle of unauthorized migrants (“protagonists”), then replicate these results in a series of controlled lab experiments. We show that information enhances the witnesses’ empathetic response and drives them to engage in more prosocial behavior when it increases their perceived interpersonal similarity, or relatability to the protagonist — an effect we trace to attention: eye-tracking data reveals that information provision concentrates witnesses’ gaze on the struggles of the protagonist instead of searching through peripheral elements of the scene. Conversely, only information packages that strengthen perceived relatability — an effect that can vary across subgroups with heterogeneous attributes — magnify empathy. Together, our evidence suggests that the ability to put oneself in the shoes of another person or group can be enhanced by activating empathy through simple, targeted, information provision.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们探讨了共情的运作机制。研究表明，当关于外群体的信息与模拟其困境的体验相结合时，能够激活并放大共情反应。这种反应会增强帮助困境群体的意愿。我们通过沉浸式虚拟现实实验为这一效应提供了证据——参与者（"见证者"）体验了未经授权移民（"主角"）的困境模拟，随后在一系列受控实验室实验中复现了这些结果。我们发现，当信息能够提升见证者感知到的人际相似性或与主角的关联性时，会增强其共情反应并促使更多亲社会行为——我们将这一效应归因于注意力机制：眼动追踪数据显示，信息提供使见证者的凝视焦点集中于主角的困境，而非搜索场景中的外围元素。反之，只有那些能强化感知关联性的信息组合（该效应可能因亚群体异质性特征而存在差异）才能放大共情。综合证据表明，通过简单、定向的信息提供激活共情，可以增强个体设身处地理解他人或群体处境的能力。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines how model uncertainty affects the price of homeowners insurance in Florida. We use unique data on expected loss rate projections from seven hurricane risk models approved by regulators for use in Florida property insurance rate filings to quantify model uncertainty. By combining these data with newly published information on local property insurance markets, we are able to empirically test the relationship between model uncertainty and insurance premiums across Florida ZIP codes and over time. Controlling for confounding variables and time-invariant latent factors that may be correlated with observed variables, we find strong empirical support for the hypothesis that greater dispersion among model forecasts leads to higher homeowners insurance premiums. Our findings suggest that, had model dispersion been ten percent lower than that observed 2021, a typical Florida homeowner would have saved $50 to $90 on her annual homeowners insurance premium.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了模型不确定性如何影响巨灾风险保险的定价。我们利用佛罗里达州监管机构批准的七个飓风风险模型所生成的预期损失率预测数据，对模型不确定性进行量化。通过将这些数据与新发布的当地财产保险市场信息相结合，我们能够从实证角度检验佛罗里达州各邮政编码区域及不同时间维度上模型不确定性与保险保费之间的关系。在控制混杂变量及可能与观测变量相关的时不变潜在因素后，我们发现了强有力的实证证据支持以下假设：模型预测结果的离散程度越大，房主保险保费越高。研究结果表明，若2021年模型离散程度比实际观测值低10%，则典型佛罗里达房主每年可节省50至90美元的房主保险保费。

title: Evaluating the environmental and economic implications of curbing transboundary pollution: Evidence from China
title_zh: 遏制跨界污染的环境与经济影响评估：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 遏制跨界污染的环境与经济影响评估：来自中国的证据

authors: Zeyang Zhang, Yuanyi Xu, Dunhu Chang, Dingding Shao, Xin Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Mitigating transboundary pollution requires internalizing environmental externalities and coordinating inter-jurisdictional interests. This paper examines the environmental and economic consequences of China's watershed ecological compensation (WEC) policy, a government-led property rights allocation scheme that combines Coasean bargaining with state-contingent contracts. By exploiting the progressive roll-out of inter-provincial WEC schemes and employing a difference-in-difference-in-differences design with a novel county-level dataset containing long-term industrial water pollutant information, we find that upstream counties experience significant reductions in pollution emissions but slower economic growth relative to their adjacent downstream counties after policy implementation. Event study estimates further indicate that environmental governance entailing high economic costs is difficult to sustain over time, reflecting a potential misalignment between costs and benefits in environmental protection. These effects can be attributed to pollution-control-oriented policy measures adopted by upstream local governments and the resulting responses of firms and residents. We further show that upstream local governments' prioritization of environmental governance is shaped by both economic and political incentives. Our findings offer insights into institutional design for improving transboundary water quality in countries with decentralized environmental management systems.
abstract_zh: 缓解跨界污染需要将环境外部性内部化并协调跨辖区利益。本文研究了中国流域生态补偿（WEC）政策的环境与经济后果，该政策是一种政府主导的产权分配机制，结合了科斯式谈判与状态依赖契约。利用省际流域生态补偿方案的逐步推广，并采用包含长期工业水污染物信息的新型县级数据集进行三重差分设计，我们发现，与相邻下游县相比，政策实施后上游县的污染排放显著减少，但经济增长速度相对放缓。事件研究估计进一步表明，涉及高经济成本的环境治理难以长期维持，反映出环境保护中成本与收益之间可能存在的错配。这些效应可归因于上游地方政府采取的以污染控制为导向的政策措施以及企业和居民的相应反应。我们进一步表明，上游地方政府对环境治理的优先排序受到经济和政治激励的双重影响。我们的研究为在环境管理分散化国家中改善跨界水质的制度设计提供了启示。

authors: Joachim De Weerdt, Luc Christiaensen, Ravi Kanbur
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines the relative importance of distance and urban prospects in migrants’ destination choice and explores its implications for understanding migration patterns across towns and cities. It uses an exceptional 18-year panel of individuals migrating from the rural and remote Kagera region of Tanzania, complemented with information on the possible destinations from the Tanzanian census. Applying dyadic regressions and controlling for individual heterogeneity, it finds that destinations farther away or with lower prospects are less likely, consistent with the literature. Education makes distance less important, and poverty at origin more. Simulations based on the estimated coefficients help explain why far more migrants from Kagera end up in towns than cities: towns are sufficiently closer to the rural poor so that their advantages of proximity outweigh their lower prospects relative to cities. Given that about two-thirds of the rural population in low-income countries live within two hours from a town, many of them poor or with little formal education, these findings open a broader discussion on the role of towns in fostering development and poverty reduction.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了距离与城市前景在移民目的地选择中的相对重要性，并分析了其对理解城镇间迁移模式的意义。研究利用了一项长达18年的面板数据，追踪了从坦桑尼亚偏远农村卡盖拉地区迁移的个体，并结合坦桑尼亚人口普查中关于可能目的地的信息。通过二元回归分析并控制个体异质性，研究发现，距离更远或前景较差的目的地被选择的概率较低，这与现有文献一致。教育水平降低了距离的重要性，而原住地的贫困状况则增强了距离的影响。基于估计系数的模拟结果有助于解释为何卡盖拉地区迁移至城镇的移民远多于城市：城镇对农村贫困人口而言距离更近，其邻近性优势足以抵消相对于城市较低的前景。鉴于低收入国家约三分之二的农村人口居住在距城镇两小时车程以内，且其中许多人贫困或教育程度有限，这些发现为探讨城镇在促进发展和减贫中的作用提供了更广泛的讨论空间。

abstract: The paper studies the canonical hold-up problem with one-sided investment by the buyer and full bargaining power by the seller. The buyer can covertly choose any distribution of valuations at a cost and privately observes her valuation. I show that, unlike in the well-understood case with linear costs, if investment costs are strictly convex, the buyer’s equilibrium utility is strictly positive and total welfare is strictly higher than when valuations are public information, thus alleviating the severity of the hold-up problem. In fact, when costs are mean-based or display decreasing risk, the equilibrium outcome might be efficient.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了买方单方面投资且卖方拥有完全议价能力的经典敲竹杠问题。买方可以秘密地以一定成本选择任意估值分布，并私下观察其估值。我证明，与线性成本下已充分理解的情形不同，若投资成本严格凸，则买方的均衡效用严格为正，且总福利严格高于估值公开信息时的情形，从而缓解了敲竹杠问题的严重性。实际上，当成本基于均值或表现出递减风险时，均衡结果可能是有效的。

abstract: ABSTRACT Addressing spatial and relocation poverty traps remains a key challenge in global poverty alleviation. This study assesses the impact of the Anti‐Poverty Relocation Centralised Resettlement policy on non‐agricultural employment using longitudinal data from 857 households (2014–2020). By applying multi‐period difference‐in‐differences, mediation analysis and difference‐in‐differences‐in‐differences models, this study systematically investigates the promotional effects of the Anti‐Poverty Relocation Centralised Resettlement policy on the non‐agricultural employment transition of relocated households. Impact pathway analysis highlights the critical role of employment opportunities and vocational training in facilitating employment transitions. In contrast, agricultural production support policies exert a concealing effect, discouraging shifts to non‐agricultural employment. The results further reveal that urban resettlement is more effective than industrial park resettlement, and that larger communities provide greater employment benefits than smaller ones. These insights offer policy recommendations for addressing spatial and relocation poverty traps.
abstract_zh: 摘要 解决空间与搬迁贫困陷阱仍是全球减贫工作中的关键挑战。本研究利用857户家庭（2014-2020年）的纵向数据，评估了易地扶贫搬迁集中安置政策对非农就业的影响。通过应用多期双重差分、中介分析及三重差分模型，本研究系统考察了易地扶贫搬迁集中安置政策对搬迁家庭非农就业转变的促进作用。影响路径分析凸显了就业机会与职业培训在促进就业转变中的关键作用。相比之下，农业生产扶持政策则呈现出遮掩效应，抑制了向非农就业的转移。研究结果进一步揭示，城镇安置较产业园区安置更为有效，且较大规模的社区比较小规模的社区能带来更大的就业效益。这些见解为应对空间与搬迁贫困陷阱提供了政策建议。

title: The cost of the consumer revolution: Prices, material living standards, and real inequality in Amsterdam (1630‒1805)
title_zh: 消费者革命的代价：阿姆斯特丹的价格、物质生活水平与真实不平等（1630‒1805）
title_primary: 消费者革命的代价：阿姆斯特丹的价格、物质生活水平与真实不平等（1630‒1805）
title_secondary: The cost of the consumer revolution: Prices, material living standards, and real inequality in Amsterdam (1630‒1805)
authors: Bas Spliet, Anne E. C. McCants
official: 官方在线 2026-04-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article measures the cost of the early modern consumer revolution through a quantitative analysis of product and process innovations in Amsterdam and examines their variegated social impact in two distinct datasets of probate inventories. It demonstrates that middle‐class decencies became substantially cheaper during the seventeenth century, nuancing the industrious revolution hypothesis in urban settings, but we also find no sustained positive impact of rising consumption on the material living standards of the labouring masses. In the eighteenth century, in fact, first‐ and second‐hand prices diverged due to the combined effects of a supply glut, the accelerating turnover of fashion, and the inherent fragility of many novel consumer goods. While elite and middling households compensated for their indulgence in consumerism with prudent ‘investment’ in more durable possessions, thereby ensuring a transferable inheritance for the next generation, our analysis documents the material impoverishment of Amsterdam's working classes during the final decades of the ancien régime . The consumer revolution, we conclude, contributed to the eighteenth‐century rise of material – or ‘real’ – inequality between the shrinking middle classes of this preindustrial metropolis on the one hand and its growing numbers of impoverished inhabitants on the other.
abstract_zh: 本文通过定量分析阿姆斯特丹的产品与工艺创新，衡量了早期现代消费革命的成本，并利用两份不同的遗嘱财产清单数据集考察了其多样化的社会影响。研究表明，十七世纪中产阶级的体面生活成本大幅下降，这为城市环境中勤勉革命假说提供了细致化视角，但我们同样发现，消费增长对劳动大众的物质生活水平并未产生持续的正向影响。事实上，在十八世纪，由于供应过剩、时尚更迭加速以及许多新型消费品固有的易损性共同作用，一手与二手价格出现分化。尽管精英和中产家庭通过审慎“投资”于更耐久的财产来弥补其消费放纵，从而确保下一代可继承的遗产，我们的分析记录了旧制度最后几十年间阿姆斯特丹工人阶级的物质贫困化。我们得出结论，消费革命促成了十八世纪这座前工业大都市中，一方面日益缩小的中产阶级与另一方面不断增多的贫困居民之间物质——或“实际”——不平等的加剧。

title: Carbon Farming Optimisation With Market Premiums for Biodiversity Co‐Benefits Under Climate Change Socio‐Economic Pathway Scenarios
title_zh: 气候变化社会经济路径情景下生物多样性协同效益市场溢价的碳农业优化
title_primary: 气候变化社会经济路径情景下生物多样性协同效益市场溢价的碳农业优化
title_secondary: Carbon Farming Optimisation With Market Premiums for Biodiversity Co‐Benefits Under Climate Change Socio‐Economic Pathway Scenarios
authors: Yuan Gao, Jeffery Connor, David Summers, Cathy Waters, Annette Cowie
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-02-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Achieving global climate change mitigation, biodiversity conservation and restoration goals requires innovative solutions that balance carbon sequestration with biodiversity conservation. Payments for ecosystem services markets often treat carbon sequestration and biodiversity separately, but integrating biodiversity as a co‐benefit within carbon farming could improve the environmental outcomes of carbon markets. This study explores the potential for carbon farming strategies in south‐eastern Australia, investigating the trade‐offs and synergies between carbon farming and biodiversity conservation. We aim to evaluate whether modest changes to carbon farming policy could influence biodiversity outcomes, carbon sequestration and economic returns. We develop an optimisation framework to evaluate two carbon farming practices, assisted natural regeneration and environmental planting, under different climate projections and policy scenarios. Our model incorporates carbon sequestration estimates and biodiversity priorities across historical climate and projected climate change defined by the shared socio‐economic pathways, specifically SSP245 and SSP585. The selection of land use change sites is optimised for two policy settings: a least‐cost carbon policy that emulates current market design, and a premium carbon credit policy that provides a 10% premium to maximise biodiversity outcomes without sacrificing carbon sequestration or economic return. Results indicate that biodiversity premiums in carbon credit payments could significantly improve biodiversity outcomes without sacrificing carbon sequestration or economic returns. Spatial analyses reveal shifts in optimal locations for carbon farming under different climate change projections. Previous research on carbon‐biodiversity trade‐offs has overlooked the impacts of current policy settings, eligibility criteria, risk factors and transaction costs. By addressing these gaps, this study provides new insights into how a moderate premium to existing policies could significantly enhance biodiversity co‐benefits within carbon credit schemes.
abstract_zh: 摘要 实现全球气候变化减缓、生物多样性保护与恢复目标，需要创新性解决方案，以平衡碳封存与生物多样性保护。生态系统服务付费市场往往将碳封存与生物多样性分开处理，但将生物多样性作为碳农业中的协同效益整合进来，可能改善碳市场的环境成效。本研究探讨了澳大利亚东南部碳农业策略的潜力，考察了碳农业与生物多样性保护之间的权衡与协同效应。我们旨在评估对碳农业政策进行适度调整是否能影响生物多样性结果、碳封存及经济回报。我们开发了一个优化框架，用于评估两种碳农业实践——辅助自然再生和环境种植，在不同气候预测和政策情景下的表现。该模型整合了历史气候及由共享社会经济路径（特别是SSP245和SSP585）定义的气候变化预测下的碳封存估算和生物多样性优先事项。土地利用变化地点的选择针对两种政策设置进行优化：一种是最低成本碳政策，模拟当前市场设计；另一种是溢价碳信用政策，提供10%的溢价，以在不牺牲碳封存或经济回报的前提下最大化生物多样性结果。结果表明，碳信用支付中的生物多样性溢价能够显著改善生物多样性结果，同时不牺牲碳封存或经济回报。空间分析揭示了不同气候变化预测下碳农业最优地点的变化。以往关于碳-生物多样性权衡的研究忽视了当前政策设置、资格标准、风险因素和交易成本的影响。通过弥补这些空白，本研究为现有政策中适度溢价如何能在碳信用计划中显著增强生物多样性协同效益提供了新见解。

title: The general solution to an autoregressive law of motion
title_zh: 自回归运动定律的通解
title_primary: 自回归运动定律的通解
title_secondary: The general solution to an autoregressive law of motion
authors: Brendan K. Beare, Massimo Franchi, Phil Howlett
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We provide a complete description of the set of all solutions to a vector autoregressive law of motion. Every solution is shown to be the sum of three components, each corresponding to a directed flow of time. One component flows forward from the arbitrarily distant past, one flows backward from the arbitrarily distant future, and one flows outward from time zero. The three components are obtained by applying three complementary spectral projections to the solution, these corresponding to a separation of the eigenvalues of the autoregressive coefficient matrix according to whether they are inside, outside, or on the unit circle. We establish a one‐to‐one correspondence between the set of all solutions and a finite‐dimensional space of initial conditions.
abstract_zh: 我们完整描述了向量自回归运动方程所有解集的构成。每个解均可分解为三个分量之和，分别对应三种时间流向：一个分量从任意遥远的过去向前流动，一个分量从任意遥远的未来向后流动，一个分量从零时刻向外扩散。这三个分量通过将三种互补谱投影算子作用于解而获得，其对应自回归系数矩阵特征值按单位圆内、外及圆上的分类。我们建立了所有解集与有限维初始条件空间之间的一一对应关系。

title: Promises and Punishment
title_zh: 承诺与惩罚
title_primary: 承诺与惩罚
title_secondary: Promises and Punishment
authors: Martin Dufwenberg, Flora Li, Alec Smith
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2021-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the effect of communication on beliefs, behavior, and efficiency in the context of trust games with a punishment option, which have the structure of hold-up problems. We apply a novel behavioral motivation, frustration-dependent anger, that links unmet payoff expectations with the willingness to forgo material payoffs to punish others, and we conjecture that communication works through this mechanism to raise expectations about the likelihood of belief-dependent costly punishment and to increase trust, cooperation, and efficiency. Promises drive the effect of communication on beliefs and broken promises lead to costly punishment. In an experiment we allow communication in the form of a single pre-play message. We measure beliefs and our design permits the observation of promises and deception. The results are consistent with the theory.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在具有惩罚选项的信任博弈中，沟通对信念、行为及效率的影响，这类博弈具有敲竹杠问题的结构。我们引入了一种新颖的行为动机——基于挫败感的愤怒，该动机将未实现的收益预期与牺牲物质收益惩罚他人的意愿联系起来，并推测沟通通过这一机制发挥作用，提升对信念依赖性高成本惩罚可能性的预期，从而增强信任、合作与效率。承诺驱动了沟通对信念的影响，而违背承诺则导致高成本惩罚。在实验中，我们允许以单一事前信息的形式进行沟通，测量了信念，并通过实验设计观察了承诺与欺骗行为。实验结果与理论预测一致。
